name: voicemem-agent
notes: v0.7.0 SUPERTONIC 3 TTS MIGRATION (operator order: REPLACE PIPER WITH SUPERTONIC 3). The production TTS is now Supertone Supertonic 3 (open-weight, ~99M params, ONNX Runtime CPU - the RTX 5070 stays reserved for the Qwen3.6 35B LLM; 31 languages incl. Hungarian and English; 44.1 kHz 16-bit mono output; MIT sample code + OpenRAIL-M model licence). Runtime: the pinned supertonic==1.3.1 PyPI SDK (the repo is ARCHIVED - a fixed external dependency); model assets download ONCE at setup time from the supertone-oss-archive/supertonic-3 repo at pinned revision aafc6e32416a into models/tts/supertonic-3 (SHA256 manifest ships as ASSET_MANIFEST.json); the runtime is fully offline (auto_download=False, code-enforced). New app/tts_supertonic.py SupertonicTtsEngine with the SAME interface contract as the retired Piper wrapper (pipeline/web call sites unchanged); the ONNX model loads ONCE (lazy) and stays alive; M2 emotion pacing maps length_scale -> SDK speed 1/length_scale (clamped 0.7-2.0); barge-in abandons the in-flight result (explicit, no fallback engine - Supertonic failure = explicit TTS error). Browser path UNCHANGED (44.1 kHz -> 24 kHz PCM16 resample at the existing web boundary); documented boundary conversion: the vocoder's 0.35-0.9 s edge padding is trimmed (supertonic_trim_silence, on by default). Voices: 10 presets (F1-F5, M1-M5; each speaks BOTH hu and en) in the UI Voice section; production default F1. PIPER REMOVED: app/tts.py deleted, binary download/verify/bootstrap/license steps and MODELS.lock tts+tools entries migrated, ~35 test expectations updated. MEASURED (sandbox 2 vCPU - target will be faster): standalone validation 15/15 OK; ASR-roundtrip gate through the PRODUCTION parakeet: HU mean WER 5.0%, EN 2.2%, insertions (repeats) 0; steps 5/8/10: the official default 8 is the best practical setting (5 measurably worse WER 11.8%); perf: load ~1.4-2.2 s, RTF 0.53-0.75 on the 2-vCPU sandbox, RAM 505 MB stable after 60 syntheses (no leak); 5 consecutive HTTP previews 200 OK; browser-verified voice selectors + turn with TTS DONE, zero console errors. The LLM/ASR/VAD/VoiceMem/E5 configuration is UNTOUCHED (Qwen3.6 35B A3B IQ4_XS ngl20 ctx32768 KVq8_0 parallel1 temp0.7 reasoning off). Gate: full sandbox battery re-run (see BUILD_HISTORY); real MixPre acceptance remains USER VERIFIED.
